container.name: CIQ Supplier Portal
container.description: Supplier portal for Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaires: answer configuration questions, complete only the relevant sections, upload evidence and respond to Beiersdorf queries.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Administrator role with full privileges for this application.

roles.name: Supplier
roles.description: Every external supplier user. Acts only on items assigned to it through Assigned_Contacts; raises change requests.

roles.name: User
roles.description: An end-user role with limited privileges.

flows.name: CIQP Request
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: Supplier-facing lifecycle of one CIQ case cycle: basic data, scope check, questionnaire, review wait, final release.
flows.descriptionModel: One CIQ case cycle as the supplier sees it: case header and the basic-data task. Created from the app case.

flows.name: CIQP Section
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: One released CIQ section of one case cycle: copied definition, the supplier's answers and uploads. Editable until the final release.
flows.descriptionModel: One released CIQ section of one case cycle: copied definition, the supplier's answers and uploads. Editable until the final release.

flows.name: CIQP Query
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: Supplier side of one Beiersdorf open point: question, reference, supplier due date, response and thread.
flows.descriptionModel: One round of a Beiersdorf question, document request or additional part. The supplier responds; the review happens in the app.

flows.name: CIQP Completeness Confirmation
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: The supplier confirms that the questionnaire is complete (PS-05). This is not the final release: data stays editable. Created from the app case.
flows.descriptionModel: The supplier confirms that the questionnaire is complete (PS-05). This is not the final release: data stays editable. Created from the app case.

flows.name: CIQP Final Release
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: The supplier's single final release of the questionnaire (PS-11). After it, nothing can be changed. Created from the app case.
flows.descriptionModel: The supplier's single final release of the questionnaire (PS-11). After it, nothing can be changed. Created from the app case.

flows.name: CIQP Notice
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: A message from Beiersdorf to the supplier, e.g. a change-request outcome, a scope change or a case closure. The supplier acknowledges it.
flows.descriptionModel: A message from Beiersdorf that the supplier acknowledges, e.g. a change-request outcome or a scope change. Not used for cancellation or closure (those go by e-mail, so no supplier task stays open).

flows.name: CIQP Change Request
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: Supplier-initiated change request: triaged by RMM, assessed by the owning department. After the final release every request is refused and logged.
flows.descriptionModel: A correction or change notice raised by the supplier. Triage and assessment happen in the app; the outcome comes back as a CIQP Notice.

flows.name: CIQP Help Article
flows.descriptionFlowRecord: Supplier-agnostic FAQ and quick-start guide (CIA #34). Every portal user may read every row by design.
flows.descriptionModel: Supplier-agnostic FAQ and quick-start guide (CIA #34). Every portal user may read every row by design.

findings.text: 9 flows: 8 Processes (7 CIQP + the throwaway ZZ Spike Assignee) and 1 Form (CIQP Help Article); 5 Lists; no Boards (case) and no Datasets. All Live, all last published on 7 Oct 2026.

No drift against kissflow-build/ciq-supplier-portal/portal-spec.mjs: every spec field exists with the spec type and Required flag, step names match, and every draft field is also in the published runtime allfields with the same type and Required flag.

Role membership changed since BUILD-LOG (7 Oct): Admin now has 0 members (was Thomas); Supplier has 1 member, Thomas (internal Kissflow user), which the 7 Oct rule 'Supplier has no internal test member' would fail. No external supplier user is in the Supplier role yet. User has 0 members.

Sharing with the app is now readable: the container flow listing GET /flow/2/{acc}/portal/CIQ_Supplier_Portal_A00/flow returns AllowedFlows per flow. Shared with CIQ Digital (Permission Lookup, all fields): CIQP Request, Section, Query, Change Request, Help Article and ZZ Spike Assignee. NOT shared: CIQP Notice, Completeness Confirmation, Final Release. Likely cause (inference): these three were created at 04:25 on 7 Oct in the v3 rebuild, after Thomas shared the flows (BUILD-LOG: around 04:13). Lists show no sharing attribute.
The app does not use the sharing yet: no app flow draft, app navigation or app integration references any portal flow id.

The portal has 0 integrations. The app has 4 (CIQ Z1 and Z2, both inactive; two ZZ Spike logs, active); none touches a portal flow. Account-wide there are 2 connections (Kissflow Dataform 1.5.4 CnEKHrH5GzkY, Kissflow Process 3.7.6 CnEKHrHqXRKB). The K-09 / X1-X6 / Y4-Y6 portal integrations do not exist.

Custom UI is enabled. One Application component CCEK4IlNaGsH, Live, source Zip, ciq-portal-ui-71810c31a7.zip (component last modified 7 Oct 10:54:29Z). Native navigation is only the default Home page (Kissflow template: 2 labels + 1 image, no flow reference).

The portal container was published on 14 Oct 2026 06:52:39Z by Thomas (VersionNumber 1.0.1, BuildNumber 1); no flow was republished. LastDeployedAt is still 7 Oct 09:38:29Z, earlier than the component upload (10:54:29Z); UI-LOG records Thomas's live Diagnostics check showing the 10:53 build, so the component publish seems to take effect without a portal redeploy (inference, not tested here).

Four flow records still carry the v2 description while the model (draft) carries the v3 one: CIQP Notice, Request, Query, Change Request. The ZZ spike has no model description. Which text Kissflow shows to users was not checked.

The key user has 0 items in My items on every CIQP process (the smoke tests deleted theirs). CIQP Help Article has 5 rows. ZZ Spike Assignee still holds 8 items from the spikes: 4 Draft at Start and 4 In progress at 'Spike step', a step that no longer exists in its workflow (Start -> End).

Every supplier step is assigned from the MultiUser field Assigned_Contacts (Resource ValueType Field). No step is owned by a role, no step has a condition, every workflow is Sequence. The draft shows no SLA, send-back, reject or e-mail switches on the activities (only the platform SendBackToInitiator activity).
Supplier role Preference is null (no default page or navigation); Admin and User have Default/Default.
